business.name: Aurekai Recipes
business.page_title: Aurekai Recipes | One base, many ways
business.description: A recipe catalogue where a dish told many times is one base with its variations. Search it, browse it, cook from it.

sections.headline: One base, *many ways.*
sections.lede: Most dishes are one recipe told again with something added. Here each is kept once, with every way of finishing it beside it.

sections.title: Find a recipe
sections.lede: Type a word, or pick a kind. Entries marked “ways” are families: one base and the variations on it.

items.title: The base
items.text: What every telling of the dish agrees on, in the same amounts. You make this each time.

items.title: The ways
items.text: Each variation is only what it adds to the base, with its own method. Open one and cook that.

items.title: As written
items.text: Recipes are their sources' words. A dish told five times with nothing changed is shown once.

sections.title: Have a collection of your own?
sections.lede: Recipes, a catalogue, records. If it is yours to publish, it can be searched from a phone like this.

form.title: Tell us about it

options.label: Recipes
options.text: A cookbook, a family file, a kitchen's binder.

form.subject: A collection to publish
form.sent: We have your note. A person will write back to the email you gave.

footer.about: A recipe catalogue by Aurekai: dishes told many times are kept as one base and its variations.

notice.title: About the recipes
notice.text: Recipes are from the public FFTS / Now You're Cooking! Meal-Master collections and remain their contributors' words. They are shown as source text: not tested, not safety advice, not nutrition advice.

to_confirm: The name “Aurekai Recipes” and the offer on the form are placeholders; say what it should be called and who answers.
Families are drawn together by a rule (same dish name, same ingredients in the same amounts); nobody has cooked them as a set. Some pair recipes that differ only in typing.
The recipes are from a public archive whose page carries a copyright notice for the site itself. Decide whether full recipe text stays before this is public.
